result: DesktopContext now accepts only generated canonical Workstream packets, stores a frozen exact WorkstreamAuthorityContext, and clears to an unbound state for malformed, non-canonical, or mismatched identity. It does not persist or derive authority from presentation state.
checks: npm --prefix apps/desktop test (exit 0; shell, Desktop context, and Mission Canvas runtime: PASS)
npm --prefix apps/desktop run check (exit 0; svelte-check: 0 errors, 0 warnings)

negative_cases.missing_workstream: Packets without an explicit generated WorkstreamKey become unbound.
negative_cases.scope_only_or_subordinate_only: A continuity-only or legacy flat project/workstream shape is rejected; subordinate IDs do not select an owner.
negative_cases.missing_authority: A generated Workstream operation packet without canonical AuthorityContext is rejected.
negative_cases.non_canonical_authority: Blocked operation authority is rejected rather than used as a Desktop binding.
negative_cases.foreign_workstream: A valid packet for another Workstream clears an existing bound store; foreign Attachment ownership is rejected by the generated validator.
negative_cases.immutability: The bound state and nested generated identity are cloned and deeply frozen; later packet mutation cannot alter the store.
negative_cases.local_presentation_state: Presentation-shaped input is not a generated packet and remains unbound.

acceptance: Context cannot be created from CWD, tab, remembered workspace, latest record, continuity alone, or local UI state.
Desktop selection cannot mint or repair authority; DesktopContext only accepts explicit generated identity and canonical authority packets.
Mismatch clears the store to an unbound state and invalidates subordinate identity.
The store uses generated WorkstreamKey, WorkstreamAuthorityContext, WorkstreamOperationRequest, and validator owners without a local identity resolver.
